> One of the candidates in question is of high quality and people don't come along very often so I would support this recruitment. 
> One of the key things for me was ensuring that anyone we hire is aware that we are operating in a highly decentralised fashion, rather than a more corporate and hierarchical fashion, therefore whoever we bring in should have a self-starting and self-motivated approach and also the ability to contribute in a community oriented fashion. 

If he likes what he sees, I think Edgeware definitely needs this high quality candidate. He can contribute to a community and chain of standing, and (partly) put his stamp on it. 

_Side-note: he is chosen to easily represent both sexes and everyone in-between._

Just following up on this.

Up until recently there hasn't been much of a roadmap for Edgeware when it comes to the bigger picture vision, but with Kabocha, the chain farming model, talk of our own relay network and keeping Edgeware as a solo chain incubator at the centre of our own little ecosystem that can be interoperable with KSM and DOT chains, the time seems right to commit to more experienced talent who can make this plan a reality. 

One of the candidates in question is of high quality and people don't come along very often so I would support this recruitment.

We have never experimented with recruitment in this way and someone will need to sign the agreement with Odiin which is attached above - likely [@Ramsey](/edgeware/account/k44nJ5yAhFz3XHGeTPuKvegJ4GD1YCSVaPc7wj4miVL6epN) or myself. 

The % requested by the recruiter James is towards the top end of fees - generally recruiters are paid a fee of 10 and 30% of the agreed salary, however the blockchain space is incredibly competitive and talent is relatively scarce. 

One of the key things for me was ensuring that anyone we hire is aware that we are operating in a highly decentralised fashion, rather than a more corporate and hierarchical fashion, therefore whoever we bring in should have a self-starting and self-motivated approach and also the ability to contribute in a community oriented fashion. 

Looking forward to other comments.
Does that mean that James takes $EDG as payment?
That is the aim yes - we are discussing that.
